title: An in-progress dedicated cleanup can leave a terminal child spuriously failed and paused
outcome: A terminal-delegation poll racing unfenced natural dedicated-runtime cleanup treats the owner as busy, and later successful confirmation cannot leave a new stale cleanup Error/pause.
acceptance: RuntimeCleanupPhase::InProgress is distinguished from Unconfirmed when a terminal child is polled; a real failed cleanup retains its existing Error, exact retry owner and public Stop path.

A deterministic owned-native-process race delivers a terminal poll while natural waiter cleanup is in progress, then confirms cleanup and proves the poll does not leave a spurious failed preview or automatic-dispatch pause; a failed-cleanup control still reports and retains failure.
